name: ledgr-monorepo
description: LogPast (Ledgr) - Past-Only Work Log & Reporting Tool (Web, PWA, Android, iOS, Desktop)

scripts.install:all: npm run install:shared && npm run install:api && npm run install:web
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.lint: npm --prefix packages/shared run lint && npm --prefix apps/api run lint && npm --prefix apps/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/shared run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
